title: Claim Evidence Map
description: DISCOVER-stage typed artifact. Current operated runs must declare claim-span/v1 and bind every locus to a local immutable snapshot plus an exact locator. Versionless maps are historical data only and may be replayed solely with an explicit citation-legacy-replay/v1 marker; they can never earn PASS. A citation existing is never sufficient evidence that it entails the claim.

attribution_contract_version.description: Required for every current operated run. Omission is accepted by the storage schema only so explicitly marked historical replays remain readable; deterministic current-run gates reject omission.

claim_id.description: must match a claim_id from a claim_list

loci.description: at least one locus is required — empty loci means the claim is unanchored

reported_result.description: The actual value or statement found at this locus. The claim-evidence-linker READS this to decide supports_claim for the locus (true = supports the claim, false = contradicts it). There is NO automatic numeric comparison: contradiction detection is the linker's explicit supports_claim decision, enforced deterministically by the gate. Always populate this for table cells, figures, and code comments so the linker can judge support correctly.

version_read.description: Exact report version inspected (version of record, accepted manuscript, or dated preprint version).

value_origin.description: Who produced the value. Equal numbers never erase attribution provenance.

derivation.description: Formula and input loci for a re-derived value or reviewer count.

suspected_source_error.description: A separate annotation; exact_quote remains verbatim even when the source appears erroneous.

page.description: Page number when the source was read from a local PDF/fulltext channel. A PASS deep read over an available local PDF should page-anchor core loci.

locator_confidence.description: How confidently this locator points to the exact paper locus rather than a broad section.

extraction_ref.description: Optional pointer to the fulltext context, table extraction, or figure read used to locate this evidence.

support_relation.description: Required by claim-span/v1. Preserves partial support and contradiction instead of collapsing all semantics into a boolean.

span_id.description: Stable identifier for this exact evidence span or visual/table locus.

snapshot_ref.description: Reference to the immutable source snapshot or extracted fulltext used by both linker and independent auditor.

document_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source snapshot bytes/text normalization used for this locator.

exact_quote.description: Short exact support excerpt used for locator verification, never a replacement for the source.

supports_claim.description: REQUIRED. The linker must explicitly decide per locus: true = this locus supports the claim; false = this locus contradicts the claim (reports the opposite). No default — omitting this field causes citation_checker.py to conservatively BLOCK (cannot verify the claim).

directness.description: OPTIONAL. How this evidence locus relates to the claim: direct = measures exactly what the claim asserts; indirect = a related quantity that implies it; proxy = a stand-in metric/surrogate; assumed = not actually shown, taken on faith. Advisory only — does not affect citation-checking.

claim_risk.description: OPTIONAL. Advisory flag for the risk that this claim is wrong or overstated relative to its evidence. Never auto-cuts or decides anything — a reading aid only.

level.description: high = claim likely overstated / weakly supported; low = well supported by direct evidence.

note.description: brief justification for the risk level, e.g. 'only proxy metrics, no direct measurement'.
